research_question: Find primary evidence linking psychedelic-space compounds to molecular targets, binding assays, pharmacology, pathway effects, or mechanistic biomarkers.

databases.name: PubMed
databases.role: Biomedical citation recall with MeSH-aware phrase and synonym searching.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture PMID, DOI, title, authors, year, MeSH terms, abstract.

databases.name: PMC
databases.role: Full-text retrieval and PMID/PMCID/DOI conversion for open biomedical articles.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture PMCID and DOI; use JATS sections for durable evidence locators.

databases.name: OpenAlex
databases.role: High-volume broad discovery, citation metadata, OA status, and concept expansion.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture OpenAlex work ID, DOI, title, year, cited_by_count, source.
databases.rate_limit_notes: Use email or OPENALEX_API_KEY for polite pool.

databases.name: Semantic Scholar
databases.role: Relevance-ranked discovery, citation graph, and related paper expansion.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture S2 paper ID, DOI, PMID, fields of study, citation/reference edges.
databases.rate_limit_notes: Use S2_API_KEY when available; throttle shared pool.

databases.name: Crossref
databases.role: DOI metadata reconciliation and publisher metadata backfill.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture DOI, title, container-title, issued date, relation metadata.
databases.rate_limit_notes: Use mailto parameter for polite pool.

databases.name: Unpaywall
databases.role: Open-access PDF and license discovery for DOI-backed papers.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture best_oa_location URL, PDF URL, license, host type.

databases.name: ChEMBL
databases.role: Binding assay and drug-target validation for compounds and targets.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture ChEMBL molecule ID, target ID, assay ID, activity type, relation, value, units.

databases.name: BindingDB
databases.role: Independent binding-affinity cross-check for compound-target assertions.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture BindingDB monomer ID, UniProt accession, Ki/Kd/IC50/EC50 values and units.
databases.rate_limit_notes: Open API or bulk files depending on volume.

databases.name: Open Targets
databases.role: Disease-target context and target-disease prior evidence.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture Ensembl target ID, EFO disease ID, score components.

databases.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
databases.role: Trial registry coverage for clinical disorder claims and unpublished evidence signals.
databases.identifier_strategy: Capture NCT ID, condition, intervention, phase, status, primary outcomes, references.

balanced_seed_profile.description: Add bounded compound-only and entity-only seeds for allowlist coverage gaps without a full Cartesian rerun.
balanced_seed_profile.when_to_use_evidence: Use evidence mode for targeted follow-up runs where evidence-type coverage matters more than runtime.

provider_specific_variants.description: Add PubMed/PMC Title/Abstract synonym queries while retaining original free-text queries.
provider_specific_variants.when_to_use_expanded: Use expanded mode only for focused comparison runs because it increases broad-provider requests.

citation_chasing.notes: Enable after initial query completeness checks pass; keep bounded until Semantic Scholar API limits are stable.

source_specific_supplements.purpose: Assay-level compound-target activity evidence independent of paper search.
Binding-affinity cross-check evidence for compound-target pairs.
Trial registry coverage, including unpublished or not-yet-linked clinical evidence.

inclusion_criteria: Primary experimental, observational, or clinical papers with extractable compound-target or compound-disorder evidence.
Reviews are retained only as citation-mining sources unless they report original data.
Preprints are retained with explicit publication-status metadata.
exclusion_criteria: Non-scientific articles, commentaries without original data, and unrelated uses of overlapping acronyms.
Rows where compound, target/disorder, or DOI/title identity cannot be normalized after reconciliation.
notes: Duplicate this template per dataset/run and commit it with the generated discovery report.
For disorder runs, replace target query blocks with disorder, outcome, trial, and registry query blocks.
